title: Phase-2 keys (X/DEL/U/1/2/E/S/B) now act on frames the old handle_input early-returned from — same-frame right-click+X demolishes the pipe the right-click just selected
location: app/input/mouse.odin:217-236 (phase-2 loop) + app/input/exec.odin:134-149 (Demolish); vs removed app/main.odin handle_input
detail: Phase-2 keys now run on frames the old handle_input early-returned from (right-press; popover/QoS/tray-swallowed left-press): same-frame right-click+X demolishes the pipe the right-click just selected; old code ignored X there. Violates hard req 1 'preserve the current behavior EXACTLY'.
recommended_fix: In mouse_map, emit phase-2 key intents only when the frame had no right-press and no UI/tray-swallowed (or placement) left-press — mirroring the old early returns — and add a same-frame key+press T1 case.
